answer: Farms remint keys after a slash, starting at a reputation nadir. Each applicant books one 16-minute night pad on a published lotus pond and must log a 685 nm fluorescence signal whose peak equals (H(pubkey||pad_id||slot) mod 64)+52 uW/cm2, taken only at solar nadir +/-6 min. Cost is 86 locked units plus pad time. Three peers re-measure the same pad and drop any refund path already on another live pad. A peak off by more than 4 uW, a missed window, or a reused pad-id burns 26 units and cools the key eight epochs; a second miss or cloned trace empties the lock and bars it fifteen epochs.
